concentration_review.first_run: 2026-08-06 — first time the standing concentration note has been expressed as a costed proposal rather than prose
read: The BAFS breach is 0.05% — THB 322 on a THB 178k position. That is far inside the uncertainty of a carried mark and should NOT be acted on. It is a good illustration of why a mechanical weight rule needs a materiality filter.

Trimming PTTEP before 2026-08-13 would forfeit ~THB 6,300 gross of entitled dividend to correct a 4.2-point weight breach. The dated income is worth more than the tidier weight; the sequencing constraint dominates.

The country line is the one that matters: TH = 100.0% against a 70% flag. Clearing all three NAME flags redistributes weight inside a book that is still entirely single-country Thai equity, and would not move the country number at all.

The cheapest available correction is the existing SCBGOLDE sleeve — ~0.50% TER, settles in THB, no new account, and the only non-Thai-equity exposure on the book. See data/research/vietnam_ftse_2026.json for why a new foreign equity position costs roughly ten times more to establish at this book size.
